verdict.rationale: Any public-facing documentation site, including a state agency's guidance pages, could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Direct probes found nothing: llms.txt returned 404, the markdown variant of a docs page returned 404, and every OpenAPI candidate path returned 404. The employer guidance pages are ordinary human-oriented web content with videos and PDFs, and nothing indicates an agent-oriented format.
